articles.title: Goldman, Wells Fargo, Morgan Stanley see tokenization as a growth play, not a threat
articles.snippet: The largest banks in the world are eyeing new trading opportunities, speeding up payments and a role for advisers as tokenization takes root in Wall Street.

articles.title: Scammer gets scammed in Ledger spy-chip exploit, loses almost $5 million in bitcoin
articles.snippet: Chainalysis says a fraudster who tricked people through fake online jobs became one of the biggest victims of the compromised hardware wallets.

articles.title: MSCI approves rules that could eject Strategy, Metaplanet from equity indexes
articles.snippet: The rules proposed in August would see companies that exist mainly to hold investments as no longer eligible for index inclusion.

articles.title: An OpenAI agent ran out of Ethereum funds, and took from a wallet it did not own
articles.snippet: The research model derived funded Sepolia addresses from public seed phrases, questioned whether using the money was ethical, then called the funds “effectively abandoned” and used them anyway.

articles.title: Bitcoin buyers snap up a brief drop below $80,000 as Asian stocks rebound
articles.snippet: Bitcoin tore back to $82,500 within two hours of dipping under $80,000, and chipmakers in Seoul recovered from their worst close since April.
